response:
## 1) Severity: MEDIUM | Type: Bug
Title: Light-theme value changed in desktop topic-post `.topic-meta-data a` (30% → 70%)

Affected:
- app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/topic-post.scss:291-291

Explanation:
The original light-theme color was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The new light branch is `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`, which is much lighter. This changes the existing light theme and reduces contrast. The dark branch (secondary 30%) also looks inverted relative to the intended mirror (secondary 70%).

Proposed fix:
~~~scss
color: dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%));
~~~

## 2) Severity: MEDIUM | Type: Bug
Title: Light-theme value changed in desktop user `.name` (30% → 50%)

Affected:
- app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/user.scss:522-522
- app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/user.scss:497-497

Explanation:
The original was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The new light branch uses 50%, which makes the name text lighter and indistinguishable from `.title`. This is an unintended light-theme regression, probably a copy-paste error.

Proposed fix:
~~~scss
color: dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%));
~~~

## 3) Severity: MEDIUM | Type: Bug
Title: Light-theme value changed in mobile modal `.custom-message-length` (70% → 30%)

Affected:
- app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/modal.scss:102-102

Explanation:
The original was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`. The new code uses 30% for primary and 70% for secondary, which swaps the pair. Light theme becomes much darker, and this no longer matches the desktop modal rule, which uses 70% and 30%.

Proposed fix:
~~~scss
color: dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%));
~~~

## 4) Severity: MEDIUM | Type: Bug
Title: Light-theme value changed in mobile topic-post `h3` (20% → 50%)

Affected:
- app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/topic-post.scss:182-182

Explanation:
The original was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)`. The new code uses 50%/50%, which lightens the heading and changes the light theme. The correct pair is 20%/80%, as used in desktop `h3`.

Proposed fix:
~~~scss
color: dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 80%));
~~~

## 5) Severity: LOW | Type: Bug
Title: Asymmetric dark-theme mapping for `p.help` and similar rules

Affected:
- app/assets/stylesheets/common/admin/admin_base.scss:506-506

Explanation:
The primary value is 40% and the secondary value is 60%, so this pair is consistent. However, other pairs in the change are not mirrored. For example, `.coldmap-*` and some `.hint` and `.date` rules should be checked for a consistent mirror of the light value.

Proposed fix:
Verify that every pair sums to 100%.
